questions.question: A block of mass $2\,\text{kg}$ is attached to a spring of force constant $200\,\text{N/m}$. If the block is displaced by $0.10\,\text{m}$ from its equilibrium position and released, its maximum speed is:
questions.explanation: For SHM, $\frac{1}{2}kA^2=\frac{1}{2}mv_{\max}^2$. Hence $v_{\max}=A\sqrt{\frac{k}{m}}=0.10\sqrt{100}=1\,\text{m/s}$.

questions.question: A projectile is fired with speed $20\,\text{m/s}$ at an angle $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. Taking $g=10\,\text{m/s}^2$, its horizontal range is:
questions.explanation: $R=\frac{u^2\sin2\theta}{g}=\frac{400\sin60^\circ}{10}=20\sqrt{3}\,\text{m}$.

questions.question: A body of mass $m$ moving with speed $u$ collides perfectly inelastically with an identical body at rest. The loss of kinetic energy is:
questions.explanation: Common speed is $u/2$. Initial KE is $\frac12mu^2$ and final KE is $\frac12(2m)(u/2)^2=\frac14mu^2$. Loss is $\frac14mu^2$.

questions.question: A satellite moves in a circular orbit of radius $R$ around Earth with speed $v$. If its orbital radius becomes $4R$, its new speed is:
questions.explanation: Orbital speed varies as $v\propto 1/\sqrt{r}$. Thus $v'=v/\sqrt4=v/2$.

questions.question: A conducting sphere of radius $R$ is charged to potential $V$. Its electrostatic energy is:
questions.explanation: Capacitance of an isolated sphere is $C=4\pi\varepsilon_0R$. Hence $U=\frac12CV^2=2\pi\varepsilon_0RV^2$.

questions.question: Two capacitors of capacitances $C$ and $2C$ are connected in series across a battery of voltage $V$. The potential difference across the capacitor $C$ is:
questions.explanation: Series capacitors carry equal charge. $C_{eq}=\frac{2C}{3}$, so $Q=\frac{2CV}{3}$. Voltage across $C$ is $Q/C=2V/3$.

questions.question: A cell of emf $E$ and internal resistance $r$ supplies current $I$ to an external resistance $R$. The terminal voltage is:
questions.explanation: For a discharging cell, terminal voltage is $V=E-Ir=IR$.

questions.question: A wire carries current $I$ in a magnetic field $B$ perpendicular to its length. If its length is doubled while current and field remain unchanged, the magnetic force becomes:
questions.explanation: $F=BIL$ for perpendicular geometry, so doubling $L$ doubles the force.

questions.question: An electron enters a uniform magnetic field perpendicular to the field with speed $v$. If its speed is doubled, its circular orbit radius becomes:
questions.explanation: The radius is $r=mv/(eB)$, hence it is directly proportional to $v$.

questions.question: A coil of $N$ turns and area $A$ rotates with angular speed $\omega$ in a uniform magnetic field $B$. The maximum induced emf is:
questions.explanation: For rotating coil, $\mathcal{E}_{\max}=NBA\omega$.

questions.question: In an AC circuit, $V_{rms}=220\,\text{V}$. The peak voltage is:
questions.explanation: $V_0=\sqrt2V_{rms}=220\sqrt2\,\text{V}$.

questions.question: A convex lens of focal length $15\,\text{cm}$ is placed in contact with a concave lens of focal length $-30\,\text{cm}$. The equivalent focal length is:
questions.explanation: $\frac1F=\frac1{15}-\frac1{30}=\frac1{30}$, hence $F=30\,\text{cm}$.

questions.question: In Young's double-slit experiment, if the wavelength is doubled while slit separation and screen distance remain unchanged, fringe width becomes:
questions.explanation: Fringe width is $\beta=\lambda D/d$, so it doubles with wavelength.

questions.question: A photon has energy $6.2\,\text{eV}$. Its approximate wavelength is:
questions.explanation: Using $\lambda(\text{nm})\approx1240/E(\text{eV})$, $\lambda\approx1240/6.2=200\,\text{nm}$.

questions.question: The work function of a metal is $2\,\text{eV}$. Light of photon energy $5\,\text{eV}$ falls on it. The maximum kinetic energy of emitted electrons is:
questions.explanation: Einstein's equation gives $K_{\max}=E_\gamma-\phi=5-2=3\,\text{eV}$.

questions.question: A radioactive sample has a half-life of $4$ hours. The fraction remaining after $12$ hours is:
questions.explanation: $12$ hours corresponds to 3 half-lives, so remaining fraction is $(1/2)^3=1/8$.

questions.question: The de Broglie wavelength of a particle with momentum $p$ is $\lambda$. If its momentum becomes $3p$, the new wavelength is:
questions.explanation: Since $\lambda=h/p$, tripling momentum makes wavelength one-third.

questions.question: A gas absorbs $500\,\text{J}$ of heat and does $200\,\text{J}$ of work. The change in internal energy is:
questions.explanation: First law: $\Delta U=Q-W=500-200=300\,\text{J}$.

questions.question: One mole of an ideal gas expands isothermally from $V$ to $3V$ at temperature $T$. Work done is:
questions.explanation: For one mole in isothermal expansion, $W=RT\ln(V_2/V_1)=RT\ln3$.

questions.question: A metal wire of length $L$ and area $A$ has Young's modulus $Y$. Its spring constant for longitudinal deformation is:
questions.explanation: Stress $=Y\times$ strain gives $F/\Delta L=YA/L$.

questions.question: A liquid drop of radius $R$ has surface tension $T$. Its excess pressure over atmosphere is:
questions.explanation: For a liquid drop with one surface, $\Delta P=2T/R$.

questions.question: A block is projected up a rough incline with initial speed $u$. If friction acts opposite motion, the acceleration while moving upward is:
questions.explanation: Both gravity component and friction act down the incline, so acceleration is $-g(\sin\theta+\mu\cos\theta)$.

questions.question: A rod of length $L$ rotates about one end with angular speed $\omega$. The speed of its midpoint is:
questions.explanation: Linear speed is $v=\omega r$; at midpoint $r=L/2$.

questions.question: A uniform disc and a uniform ring have the same mass and radius and roll without slipping with the same speed. Which has greater total kinetic energy?
questions.explanation: $K=\frac12Mv^2+\frac12I\omega^2$. The ring has $I=MR^2$, larger than the disc's $MR^2/2$.

questions.question: For a simple pendulum of length $L$, the time period is $T$. If its length is changed to $9L$, the new period is:
questions.explanation: $T\propto\sqrt L$, so $T'=\sqrt9T=3T$.

questions.question: The pH of a $0.001\,\text{M}$ strong monoprotic acid is approximately:
questions.explanation: For a strong acid, $[H^+]=10^{-3}\,\text{M}$, so pH $=3$.

questions.question: For a first-order reaction, the half-life is $20$ minutes. The time required for $87.5\%$ completion is:
questions.explanation: Remaining fraction is $12.5\%=1/8=(1/2)^3$, so three half-lives are required: $60$ min.

questions.question: For the reaction $N_2+3H_2\rightleftharpoons2NH_3$, increasing pressure at constant temperature shifts equilibrium toward:
questions.explanation: There are 4 moles of gaseous reactants and 2 moles of gaseous products, so higher pressure favors products.

questions.question: The oxidation state of sulfur in $H_2SO_4$ is:
Which species is paramagnetic?
questions.explanation: Molecular orbital theory shows $O_2$ has two unpaired electrons in $\pi^*$ orbitals.

questions.question: The hybridisation of the central atom in $SF_6$ is:
questions.explanation: Six sigma bonds around sulfur correspond to octahedral arrangement and $sp^3d^2$ hybridisation.

questions.question: Among the following, the strongest oxidising agent under standard conditions is the species with the:
questions.explanation: A more positive standard reduction potential indicates greater tendency to undergo reduction and hence stronger oxidising character.

questions.question: The molarity of a solution containing $4\,\text{g}$ of $NaOH$ in $500\,\text{mL}$ solution is:
questions.explanation: Moles of NaOH $=4/40=0.1$. Volume $=0.5$ L, so molarity $=0.2\,M$.

questions.question: Which molecule has the highest bond angle?
questions.explanation: $BF_3$ is trigonal planar with bond angle $120^\circ$, larger than the others listed.

questions.question: The major product of addition of HBr to propene in the absence of peroxide is:
questions.explanation: In the absence of peroxide, HBr adds by Markovnikov's rule to give 2-bromopropane.

questions.question: Which compound gives a positive iodoform test?
questions.explanation: Ethanol is oxidised to ethanal, which contains the required $CH_3CO-$ group for the iodoform reaction.

questions.question: The number of stereoisomers possible for 2,3-dichlorobutane is:
questions.explanation: It has two stereocentres and a meso form, giving three stereoisomers in total.

questions.question: Which reagent converts an alkene into a vicinal dihalide?
questions.explanation: Bromine adds across the double bond to form a vicinal dibromide.

questions.question: The major product of dehydration of 2-methyl-2-butanol is:
questions.explanation: Dehydration follows Zaitsev's rule; the more substituted alkene, 2-methyl-2-butene, predominates.

questions.question: Which of the following is a strong field ligand?
questions.explanation: $CN^-$ is a strong-field ligand and causes significant splitting in coordination complexes.

questions.question: The coordination number of the central metal ion in $[Co(NH_3)_5Cl]^{2+}$ is:
questions.explanation: There are five $NH_3$ ligands and one $Cl^-$ ligand directly attached to cobalt, giving coordination number $6$.

questions.question: The geometry of $[Ni(CN)_4]^{2-}$ is generally:
questions.explanation: $CN^-$ is strong field and $Ni^{2+}$ in this complex forms a square-planar $dsp^2$ arrangement.

questions.question: The major product of nitration of benzene is:
questions.explanation: Electrophilic substitution of benzene with nitrating mixture gives nitrobenzene.

questions.question: Which group is meta-directing in electrophilic aromatic substitution?
questions.explanation: The strongly electron-withdrawing $-NO_2$ group is deactivating and meta-directing.

questions.question: The product of reduction of nitrobenzene with $Sn/HCl$ is:
questions.explanation: $Sn/HCl$ reduces the nitro group to an amino group, giving aniline.

questions.question: The monomer used to prepare PVC is:
questions.explanation: PVC is polyvinyl chloride, formed by polymerisation of $CH_2=CHCl$.

questions.question: The number of $\sigma$ bonds in ethyne, $C_2H_2$, is:
questions.explanation: There are three sigma bonds: one C-C and two C-H bonds.

questions.question: For an ideal gas, the compressibility factor $Z$ is:
questions.explanation: For an ideal gas, $PV=nRT$, so $Z=PV/(nRT)=1$.

questions.question: The enthalpy change for formation of one mole of a compound from its elements in their standard states is called:
questions.explanation: This is the definition of standard enthalpy of formation.

questions.question: Which of the following has the highest boiling point due to strong hydrogen bonding?
questions.explanation: Water forms an extensive three-dimensional hydrogen-bond network, giving it an unusually high boiling point.

questions.question: If $z=3+4i$, then $|z|^2$ is:
The coefficient of $x^3$ in $(1+x)^8$ is:
questions.explanation: Coefficient is ${}^{8}C_3=56$.

questions.question: If the roots of $x^2-6x+k=0$ are equal, then $k$ is:
questions.explanation: Equal roots require discriminant zero: $36-4k=0$, hence $k=9$.

questions.question: The value of $\sum_{r=1}^{10}r$ is:
The determinant $\begin{vmatrix}2&1\\3&4\end{vmatrix}$ is:
questions.explanation: Determinant $=2(4)-1(3)=5$.

questions.question: If $\vec a\cdot\vec b=0$ for two non-zero vectors, the angle between them is:
questions.explanation: $\vec a\cdot\vec b=|a||b|\cos\theta=0$ and both vectors are non-zero, so $\theta=90^\circ$.

questions.question: The equation of the tangent to $y=x^2$ at $x=1$ is:
questions.explanation: At $(1,1)$, slope is $2$. Hence $y-1=2(x-1)$, or $y=2x-1$.

questions.question: The maximum value of $x(4-x)$ for real $x$ is:
questions.explanation: $x(4-x)=4-(x-2)^2$, so maximum value is $4$.

questions.question: The integral $\int_0^1 2x\,dx$ equals:
The derivative of $x^x$ for $x>0$ is:
questions.explanation: Taking logarithms, $\ln y=x\ln x$ gives $y'/y=\ln x+1$, hence $y'=x^x(\ln x+1)$.

questions.question: The limit $\lim_{x\to0}\frac{e^x-1}{x}$ is:
questions.explanation: This is the standard exponential limit and equals $1$.

questions.question: The distance between points $(1,2)$ and $(4,6)$ is:
The equation of the circle with centre $(2,-1)$ and radius $3$ is:
questions.explanation: Circle equation is $(x-h)^2+(y-k)^2=r^2$.

questions.question: The eccentricity of a parabola is:
questions.explanation: Every parabola has eccentricity $e=1$.

questions.question: The eccentricity of a hyperbola is always:
questions.explanation: A hyperbola has $e>1$.

questions.question: If $\tan\theta=1$ and $0<\theta<\pi/2$, then $\theta$ is:
questions.explanation: In the first quadrant, $\tan\theta=1$ gives $\theta=\pi/4$.

questions.question: The principal value of $\cos^{-1}(-1)$ is:
questions.explanation: The principal range of $\cos^{-1}x$ is $[0,\pi]$, so $\cos^{-1}(-1)=\pi$.

questions.question: The probability of getting exactly one head when two fair coins are tossed is:
questions.explanation: Favourable outcomes are HT and TH, so probability is $2/4=1/2$.

questions.question: The mean of $3,5,7,9,11$ is:
The variance of the numbers $1,1,1,1$ is:
questions.explanation: All observations are equal, so every deviation from the mean is zero and variance is $0$.

questions.question: If $A$ is a $3\times3$ matrix and $|A|=2$, then $|2A|$ is:
questions.explanation: For an $n\times n$ matrix, $|kA|=k^n|A|$. Thus $|2A|=2^3\times2=16$.

questions.question: The general solution of $\frac{dy}{dx}=3x^2$ is:
questions.explanation: Integrating gives $y=\int3x^2dx=x^3+C$.

questions.question: The area enclosed between $y=x$ and the $x$-axis from $x=0$ to $x=2$ is:
If $\alpha,\beta$ are roots of $x^2-5x+6=0$, then $\alpha^2+\beta^2$ is:
questions.explanation: $\alpha+\beta=5$ and $\alpha\beta=6$. Hence $\alpha^2+\beta^2=25-12=13$.

questions.question: The number of ways of choosing $3$ students from $8$ students is:
questions.explanation: Number of choices is ${}^{8}C_3=56$.
